messages.subject: Project Onyx — draft Report on Title
messages.plaintextBody:
Tom,

We've issued our draft Report on Title (Project_Onyx_ReportOnTitle_DRAFT) to you via the data room. Headlines: good absolute freehold title; £1.329m passing rent; net initial yield c.6.67%; one charge to discharge (Pennine Business Bank, undertaking to be obtained); Unit D the main reversionary risk with a small rent arrears. Searches all clear. No red flags that would stop us proceeding.

We'll finalise once the outstanding enquiries (rent deposits, HMRC option acknowledgement) are closed. Happy to talk it through.

James

James Osei
Senior Associate | Real Estate
Whitfield Carter LLP
+44 (0)20 7946 0531
